headline: Expanse Swings to Wardens; Passage Guns Fall Quiet
war_summary: The front has shifted once more. The Weathered Expanse, which at the last edition stood five Colonial works to two Warden and two unclaimed, is now counted four Warden, two Colonial and three unclaimed, with thirteen events filed in the past two hours and fifty-eight across the day, making it the busiest district on the map and the last to report, its newest entry arriving as this edition closed. Callahan's Passage, still eight Warden works against two Colonial, has gone comparatively quiet: six events in six hours after thirty-five in the day, and nothing since early evening. The Nevish Line holds at seven Warden to one Colonial, likewise cooling. Palantine Berm is the sharpest live contest, four Warden works against three Colonial, thirty events in the day and ten within two hours, its latest at 11:55. Stlican Shelf now reads seven Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed; Stonecradle eight Colonial to one Warden. Casualty rolls run heaviest in the Expanse, at 7,828 Colonial and 11,634 Warden over the day, and in Callahan's Passage. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and eleventh day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
